user.title: Kohler Anthem Setup
user.description: Enter your Kohler Konnect credentials and API keys. See [setup docs]({docs_url}) for instructions, including how to obtain a B2C refresh token (required for outlet/valve writes).

data_description.b2c_refresh_token: Required for outlet/valve/preset writes. Run `python -m kohler_anthem.b2c_signin url` in a Python venv with kohler-anthem installed, sign in via the browser, copy the msauth:// URL from the address bar, then run `python -m kohler_anthem.b2c_signin exchange '<url>'` to print the refresh token. Paste the result here.

reauth_confirm.title: Kohler Anthem — Refresh Token Expired
reauth_confirm.description: Your B2C refresh token was rejected. Run `python -m kohler_anthem.b2c_signin url` and `exchange` again, then paste the new refresh token below.

error.invalid_b2c_refresh_token: B2C refresh token is invalid or expired
error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Kohler API
error.cannot_discover: Could not discover devices. Check your credentials.
